ai_technology: TabPFN tabular foundation model; Gemini 3 Pro language model; agronomist-reviewed grower-in-the-loop scheduling

evidence.ai_role: TabPFN predicts yield anchors for a nitrogen-response curve; Gemini 3 Pro proposes bounded schedule revisions from grower/weather constraints, each reviewed by an agronomist.
evidence.tested: Initial within-study field tests at two commercial sites in 2025–26, four plots per treatment; recommendations at sowing and agronomist-reviewed in-season adjustments preceded harvest measurements. Retrospective long-term model evaluations and earlier field seasons are ancillary evidence.
evidence.unknown: Nonsignificant yield differences are not equivalence. Sites were not replicated within season; wider transfer, grain-quality trade-offs and environmental benefit remain unestablished. Earlier measured N2O differences were nonsignificant.

organization: University of Sheffield; Zhejiang University of Technology; Harper Adams University; Velcourt Limited; Rothamsted Research

source_review.scope: Primary arXiv v1 fullHTML Results and Methods 3.7 field trials, 3.8 in-season protocol, 3.9 statistics; source date/affiliations, prior protein shortfalls, intervention-error logs and emissions limits checked. Level 3 classifies initial within-study pilot direct tests, not independent follow-up or sustained deployment.

summary: A preprint coupled TabPFN nitrogen-response recommendations with Gemini 3 Pro schedule adjustments reviewed by an agronomist. In 2025–26 commercial field trials at two sites, treatments used 24.1% and 12.5% less nitrogen than standard practice, with no statistically significant yield differences; four replicate plots per treatment and no equivalence test limit any claim of preserved yield. Earlier 2024–25 static recommendations lowered grain protein at all five sites, significantly at several; one in-season LLM error was caught by agronomist review. These small within-study pilots do not establish general farming benefit or reduced emissions.
title: Grower-guided AI reduces nitrogen use in two wheat field pilots
